instruction.task: Implement Phase 1, Slice 3 of the Agency Command Center ERP.
instruction.objective: Build the operational checklist layer: workflows, tasks, assignment, status updates, completion calculation, and workflow detail UI.

section.title: 1. Workflow Detail and Listing
section.requirement: Implement GET /api/workflows with tenant filters by client, status, and project manager.
Implement GET /api/workflows/:id returning workflow, client summary, tasks, completion percentage, and open blocker count.
Implement GET /api/clients/:id/workflows with tenant ownership validation.
Build workflow detail screen with checklist, assignee, due date, priority, status badge, blocker indicator, and progress bar.

section.title: 2. Task Management
section.requirement: Implement POST /api/workflows/:id/tasks for PM/Admin custom tasks with DTO validation.
Implement PATCH /api/tasks/:id for status, assignee, due_date, priority, title, and description updates.
Implement PATCH /api/tasks/:id/complete. Set completed_at and completed_by.
PM/Admin may assign tasks. Team Members may update only assigned tasks.
Build task update controls for allowed users using React Hook Form + Zod where editing is form-based.

section.title: 3. Completion and Deadline Logic
section.requirement: Recalculate workflow completion as completed_tasks / total_tasks * 100 after task mutations.
Highlight overdue tasks in red and due-soon tasks in amber in checklist UI.
Write activity logs for task creation, assignment, update, completion, and status changes.

logic.description: A blocked task cannot be completed directly.
Task access must verify Task to Workflow to Client to Tenant ownership.
Drag-and-drop reorder is Should priority only; implement stable sort_order editing before complex drag UI.

item.req: List, detail, client workflows, completion calculation
Create, update, assign, complete, due dates, priority
Workflow detail and task update UI

instruction.first_principles_check: A workflow is the operational container. A task is the smallest executable unit. All status changes must be tenant-safe, role-safe, transition-safe, and auditable.
